Name: Simple Birthday Gifts
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=4][b]Simply Birthday Gifts[/b] helps you find the right birthday present without leaving the game. Hover over a villager’s birthday on the calendar to see their loved and liked gifts in a tidy panel with item icons.
Gifts you already have in your backpack appear first, highlighted in green with their quantities, so you can quickly spot something ready to give.

[b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=4]Loved and liked gifts displayed side by side.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Item icons, backpack highlights, and quantity badges.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]A warm, muted interface that fits Stardew Valley.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Works with town and home calendars.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Supports custom NPCs and items that use the game’s standard birthday and gift systems.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Includes all 12 built-in game languages.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]How to use[/b]
Hover over a birthday and browse with the mouse wheel, Page Up/Page Down, or controller shoulder buttons. Gift preferences are shown even if you haven’t discovered them yet. Backpack highlights do not include items stored in chests.

[b]Installation[/b]
Requires [b]SMAPI 4.4.0+[/b] and [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b]. Extract the mod into your [b]Mods[/b] folder and launch through SMAPI.[/size]
